objects.description: Opaque decoder handle type for the FAAD2 (NeAACDec) decoder. It is a pointer-sized opaque token managed by the API and represents a decoder instance. Treat it as an opaque handle; do not dereference. Lifetime is created with NeAACDecOpen (or NeAACDecInitDRM which outputs a handle) and destroyed with NeAACDecClose.
Parsed representation of MPEG-4 AudioSpecificConfig, including core AAC parameters and SBR-related flags. Used as output for NeAACDecAudioSpecificConfig to interpret DecoderSpecificInfo/ASC blobs.

Decoder configuration structure controlling default object type, sample rate, desired PCM output format, downmixing, ADTS compatibility, and implicit SBR upsampling behavior. Obtain a pointer via NeAACDecGetCurrentConfiguration, modify fields, and apply with NeAACDecSetConfiguration before decoding.

Per-decode-call frame metadata returned by the decoder, including bytes consumed, sample count, channel count, error code, sample rate, SBR/PS flags, header type, and detailed channel layout. Pass a pointer to NeAACDecDecode/NeAACDecDecode2; it is filled on return.

functions.name: NeAACDecGetErrorMessage
functions.signature: char* NeAACDecGetErrorMessage(unsigned char errcode);
functions.description: Returns a human-readable string for an error code produced by the decoder (e.g., values placed in NeAACDecFrameInfo.error). Use this to translate error codes to messages for logging or diagnostics.
requirements: errcode is typically a value obtained from NeAACDecFrameInfo.error.
The returned pointer refers to an internal static string; do not free or modify it.

functions.name: NeAACDecGetCapabilities
functions.signature: unsigned long NeAACDecGetCapabilities(void);
functions.description: Returns a bitmask of decoder capabilities (e.g., LC_DEC_CAP, MAIN_DEC_CAP, LTP_DEC_CAP, LD_DEC_CAP, ERROR_RESILIENCE_CAP, FIXED_POINT_CAP). Useful for feature probing before initialization.
requirements: No arguments; callable at any time before or after creating a decoder handle.
Interpret the returned bitmask using the FAAD2 capability macros defined in the header.

functions.name: NeAACDecOpen
functions.signature: NeAACDecHandle NeAACDecOpen(void);
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new decoder handle. This handle is used for subsequent configuration, initialization, decoding, and close operations.
requirements: Must be called before NeAACDecGetCurrentConfiguration/NeAACDecSetConfiguration and before any Init/Decode call.
The returned handle must later be closed with NeAACDecClose to avoid leaks.
Do not use the handle after it has been closed.

functions.name: NeAACDecGetCurrentConfiguration
functions.signature: NeAACDecConfigurationPtr NeAACDecGetCurrentConfiguration(NeAACDecHandle hDecoder);
functions.description: Retrieves a pointer to the current decoder configuration structure for the given handle. Callers can inspect or modify fields and then apply them with NeAACDecSetConfiguration.
requirements: hDecoder must be a valid handle returned by NeAACDecOpen (or successfully initialized for DRM).
The returned configuration pointer is owned by the decoder; do not free it.
After changing fields in the config, call NeAACDecSetConfiguration to apply them.

functions.name: NeAACDecSetConfiguration
functions.signature: unsigned char NeAACDecSetConfiguration(NeAACDecHandle hDecoder, NeAACDecConfigurationPtr config);
functions.description: Applies the provided configuration to the decoder. Typically used after retrieving and editing the current configuration via NeAACDecGetCurrentConfiguration.
requirements: hDecoder must be a valid decoder handle obtained from NeAACDecOpen.
config must be a valid pointer to a NeAACDecConfiguration (e.g., obtained from NeAACDecGetCurrentConfiguration and potentially modified).
Check the return value to ensure the configuration was accepted (nonzero indicates success in FAAD2 convention; exact semantics not documented here).

functions.name: NeAACDecInit
functions.signature: long NeAACDecInit(NeAACDecHandle hDecoder, unsigned char *buffer, unsigned long buffer_size, unsigned long *samplerate, unsigned char *channels);
functions.description: Initializes the decoder for ADTS/ADIF/LATM/RAW streams using header information found in the provided input buffer. On success it outputs the detected sample rate and channel count.
requirements: hDecoder must be a valid handle from NeAACDecOpen.
buffer must point to encoded AAC stream data beginning at a header; buffer_size specifies its size in bytes and must be large enough to contain the necessary header.
samplerate must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the detected sample rate.
channels must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the detected channel count.
Call this once before the first NeAACDecDecode on the stream (unless using NeAACDecInit2/NeAACDecInitDRM instead).
Use the return value (long) to check for success; exact error codes are library-defined (not documented here).

functions.name: NeAACDecInit2
functions.signature: char NeAACDecInit2(NeAACDecHandle hDecoder, unsigned char *pBuffer, unsigned long SizeOfDecoderSpecificInfo, unsigned long *samplerate, unsigned char *channels);
functions.description: Initializes the decoder using an MPEG-4 DecoderSpecificInfo (AudioSpecificConfig) blob rather than scanning ADTS/ADIF headers. On success returns sample rate and channel count.
requirements: hDecoder must be a valid handle from NeAACDecOpen.
pBuffer must point to the DecoderSpecificInfo (AudioSpecificConfig) data; SizeOfDecoderSpecificInfo is its size in bytes.
samplerate must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the detected sample rate.
channels must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the detected channel count.
Call prior to decoding if you have container-provided AudioSpecificConfig (e.g., MP4/ISO BMFF).
Check the return value (char) for success/failure; exact semantics not documented here.

functions.name: NeAACDecInitDRM
functions.signature: char NeAACDecInitDRM(NeAACDecHandle *hDecoder, unsigned long samplerate, unsigned char channels);
functions.description: Initializes the decoder for DRM ER LC profiles using explicit sample rate and channel count, creating or configuring the decoder through a handle pointer.
requirements: hDecoder must be a valid pointer to a NeAACDecHandle variable; the function will initialize/configure the handle for DRM decoding.
samplerate must be a valid sample rate value expected by the stream.
channels must be the channel count expected by the DRM stream (see DRM channel definitions).
Call before any decoding of DRM streams.
Check the return value (char) for success/failure; exact semantics not documented here.

functions.name: NeAACDecPostSeekReset
functions.signature: void NeAACDecPostSeekReset(NeAACDecHandle hDecoder, long frame);
functions.description: Notifies the decoder that a seek has occurred and resets internal state accordingly. The frame parameter indicates the new frame index/time reference for error concealment/synchronization.
requirements: hDecoder must be a valid decoder handle.
Call this immediately after an application-level seek in the input stream and before resuming NeAACDecDecode.
frame should be the target frame index (units not further documented here).

functions.name: NeAACDecClose
functions.signature: void NeAACDecClose(NeAACDecHandle hDecoder);
functions.description: Releases all resources associated with the decoder handle and invalidates it.
requirements: hDecoder must be a valid decoder handle previously returned by NeAACDecOpen/initialized via Init/InitDRM.
After this call, the handle must not be used again unless reopened.
Call exactly once for each successful NeAACDecOpen to avoid resource leaks.

functions.name: NeAACDecDecode
functions.signature: void* NeAACDecDecode(NeAACDecHandle hDecoder, NeAACDecFrameInfo *hInfo, unsigned char *buffer, unsigned long buffer_size);
functions.description: Decodes AAC data from the provided input buffer and returns a pointer to the decoded PCM samples. Decoding details and status (bytes consumed, samples produced, error code, etc.) are returned in hInfo.
requirements: hDecoder must be a valid, initialized decoder (via NeAACDecInit/NeAACDecInit2/NeAACDecInitDRM).
hInfo must be a non-NULL pointer to a writable NeAACDecFrameInfo structure; the decoder fills it each call.
buffer must point to encoded AAC data; buffer_size is its size in bytes. For reliable decoding, at least FAAD_MIN_STREAMSIZE bytes per channel should be available.
The returned pointer refers to a buffer with decoded samples; ownership and lifetime are not documented in the header—do not free unless documentation elsewhere states otherwise.
On errors, inspect hInfo->error and translate via NeAACDecGetErrorMessage.

functions.name: NeAACDecDecode2
functions.signature: void* NeAACDecDecode2(NeAACDecHandle hDecoder, NeAACDecFrameInfo *hInfo, unsigned char *buffer, unsigned long buffer_size, void **sample_buffer, unsigned long sample_buffer_size);
functions.description: Decodes AAC data like NeAACDecDecode but additionally allows the caller to supply/output a sample buffer through sample_buffer and its size. Returns a pointer to the decoded samples (which may refer to the supplied buffer).
requirements: hDecoder must be a valid, initialized decoder.
hInfo must be a non-NULL pointer to a writable NeAACDecFrameInfo.
buffer must point to encoded AAC data of length buffer_size bytes.
sample_buffer must be a valid pointer to a pointer variable that (per naming and signature) refers to a writable buffer; sample_buffer_size specifies that buffer’s size in bytes.
Ensure sample_buffer_size is sufficient for the decoded frame to avoid overruns; exact required size depends on output format/channels and is not documented here.
Inspect hInfo->error on failure; translate with NeAACDecGetErrorMessage.

functions.name: NeAACDecAudioSpecificConfig
functions.signature: char NeAACDecAudioSpecificConfig(unsigned char *pBuffer, unsigned long buffer_size, mp4AudioSpecificConfig *mp4ASC);
functions.description: Parses an MPEG-4 AudioSpecificConfig (DecoderSpecificInfo) from a raw buffer into an mp4AudioSpecificConfig structure. Useful for probing or preparing NeAACDecInit2 inputs.
requirements: pBuffer must point to the AudioSpecificConfig bitstream; buffer_size is its size in bytes.
mp4ASC must be a non-NULL pointer to a writable mp4AudioSpecificConfig struct to receive parsed fields.
Check the return value (char) for success/failure; exact semantics not documented here.

functions.name: NeAACDecGetVersion
functions.signature: int NeAACDecGetVersion(char **faad_id_string, char **faad_copyright_string);
functions.description: Retrieves version and copyright strings for FAAD2. On success, both output parameters are set to NUL-terminated strings.
requirements: faad_id_string must be a non-NULL pointer to a char* to receive the ID/version string.
faad_copyright_string must be a non-NULL pointer to a char* to receive the copyright string.
Do not free or modify the returned strings unless library documentation explicitly allows it.
Check the integer return value for success; exact semantics not documented here.

functions.name: faacDecGetErrorMessage
functions.signature: char* NeAACDecGetErrorMessage(unsigned char errcode);
functions.description: Backwards-compatibility alias to NeAACDecGetErrorMessage. Returns a human-readable string for a decoder error code.
requirements: errcode is typically a value obtained from NeAACDecFrameInfo.error.
The returned pointer refers to an internal static string; do not free or modify it.

functions.name: faacDecSetConfiguration
functions.signature: unsigned char NeAACDecSetConfiguration(NeAACDecHandle hDecoder, NeAACDecConfigurationPtr config);
functions.description: Backwards-compatibility alias to NeAACDecSetConfiguration. Applies the provided configuration to the decoder.
requirements: hDecoder must be a valid decoder handle obtained from NeAACDecOpen.
config must be a valid pointer to a NeAACDecConfiguration.
Check the return value to ensure the configuration was accepted.

functions.name: faacDecGetCurrentConfiguration
functions.signature: NeAACDecConfigurationPtr NeAACDecGetCurrentConfiguration(NeAACDecHandle hDecoder);
functions.description: Backwards-compatibility alias to NeAACDecGetCurrentConfiguration. Retrieves a pointer to the current decoder configuration for the given handle.
requirements: hDecoder must be a valid handle returned by NeAACDecOpen.
Do not free the returned pointer; apply changes via faacDecSetConfiguration/NeAACDecSetConfiguration.

functions.name: faacDecInit
functions.signature: long NeAACDecInit(NeAACDecHandle hDecoder, unsigned char *buffer, unsigned long buffer_size, unsigned long *samplerate, unsigned char *channels);
functions.description: Backwards-compatibility alias to NeAACDecInit. Initializes the decoder from ADTS/ADIF/LATM/RAW header data in the provided buffer.
requirements: hDecoder must be a valid handle from NeAACDecOpen.
buffer must point to encoded AAC stream header data; buffer_size is its size in bytes.
samplerate and channels must be valid output pointers.
Call before decoding when not using Init2/InitDRM.

functions.name: faacDecInit2
functions.signature: char NeAACDecInit2(NeAACDecHandle hDecoder, unsigned char *pBuffer, unsigned long SizeOfDecoderSpecificInfo, unsigned long *samplerate, unsigned char *channels);
functions.description: Backwards-compatibility alias to NeAACDecInit2. Initializes the decoder using an AudioSpecificConfig blob.
requirements: hDecoder must be a valid handle from NeAACDecOpen.
pBuffer must point to DecoderSpecificInfo; SizeOfDecoderSpecificInfo is its size in bytes.
samplerate and channels must be valid output pointers.

functions.name: faacDecInitDRM
functions.signature: char NeAACDecInitDRM(NeAACDecHandle *hDecoder, unsigned long samplerate, unsigned char channels);
functions.description: Backwards-compatibility alias to NeAACDecInitDRM. Initializes the decoder for DRM ER LC decoding using explicit sample rate and channel count.
requirements: hDecoder must be a valid pointer to a NeAACDecHandle variable.
samplerate and channels must describe the DRM stream to be decoded.
Check return value for success.

functions.name: faacDecPostSeekReset
functions.signature: void NeAACDecPostSeekReset(NeAACDecHandle hDecoder, long frame);
functions.description: Backwards-compatibility alias to NeAACDecPostSeekReset. Resets decoder state after a seek to the specified frame index.
requirements: hDecoder must be a valid handle.
Call after seeking in the input stream and before resuming decoding.
frame should indicate the new position (units not documented here).

functions.name: faacDecOpen
functions.signature: NeAACDecHandle NeAACDecOpen(void);
functions.description: Backwards-compatibility alias to NeAACDecOpen. Allocates and returns a new decoder handle.
requirements: Call before configuration/initialization/decoding.
Close the handle with faacDecClose/NeAACDecClose when done.

functions.name: faacDecClose
functions.signature: void NeAACDecClose(NeAACDecHandle hDecoder);
functions.description: Backwards-compatibility alias to NeAACDecClose. Frees resources associated with the decoder handle.
requirements: hDecoder must be a valid handle.
Do not use the handle after closing; call exactly once per opened handle.

functions.name: faacDecDecode
functions.signature: void* NeAACDecDecode(NeAACDecHandle hDecoder, NeAACDecFrameInfo *hInfo, unsigned char *buffer, unsigned long buffer_size);
functions.description: Backwards-compatibility alias to NeAACDecDecode. Decodes AAC data from the buffer and returns decoded PCM samples, with status in hInfo.
requirements: hDecoder must be initialized via Init/Init2/InitDRM.
hInfo must be a valid writable pointer.
buffer must point to encoded data of length buffer_size bytes.
Use hInfo->error to detect errors and translate with faacDecGetErrorMessage/NeAACDecGetErrorMessage.

data_types.description: Raw bytes from an AAC stream containing initial headers or contiguous bitstream data suitable for initialization (ADTS, ADIF, LATM/LOAS, or RAW with in-band config). Typically begins at a sync/header and includes enough bytes (tens to hundreds) for the decoder to parse sample rate and channel configuration.

Binary AudioSpecificConfig as defined by MPEG-4 (ISO/IEC 14496-3). A compact DecoderSpecificInfo blob carrying object type, sampling frequency index or explicit frequency, and channel configuration, optionally with GASpecificConfig and SBR/PS extension elements. Usually 2–5 bytes for basic LC AAC, up to a few dozen bytes with extensions.

Raw encoded AAC frame bytes as they would appear during decoding calls. May be ADTS-framed frames, LATM/LOAS packets, or raw AAC access units depending on initialization mode. Contains one or more frames of compressed audio payload; decoder consumes some prefix and produces PCM samples.

import random
from typing import List, Tuple

# This generator returns bytes intended to be used as initial AAC input buffers for
# NeAACDecInit/faacDecInit fuzz stubs. It focuses on producing valid-looking AAC
# headers for the common stream types that FAAD2 can auto-detect:
# - ADTS frames (MPEG-2/4 AAC, syncword 0xFFF)
# - ADIF header ("ADIF" at start)
# - LATM/LOAS (AudioSyncStream with 0x56 0xE0 sync)
# - RAW access units preceded by a plausible ADTS-like header (fallback kept to ADTS)
# The stubs read up to 1024 bytes and require that the decoder can extract
# samplerate and channels from the initial header, so we ensure the first bytes
# provide enough header fields and at least one frame worth of payload.

# Sampling frequency index mapping per MPEG-4 AAC (ISO/IEC 14496-3)
_SF_TABLE: List[Tuple[int, int]] = [
    (0, 96000), (1, 88200), (2, 64000), (3, 48000), (4, 44100), (5, 32000),
    (6, 24000), (7, 22050), (8, 16000), (9, 12000), (10, 11025), (11, 8000),
    (12, 7350)
]

# Channel configuration mapping (index -> channels). Others map to unknown (0)
_CH_TABLE = {
    0: 0,
    1: 1,  # mono
    2: 2,  # stereo
    3: 3,
    4: 4,
    5: 5,
    6: 6,
    7: 8,  # 7.1
}


def _rand_choice(rng: random.Random, items):
    return items[rng.randrange(0, len(items))]


def _make_adts_header(rng: random.Random, 
                      profile: int,
                      sf_idx: int,
                      chan_cfg: int,
                      aac_frame_length: int,
                      mpeg_version: int = 0,
                      protection_absent: int = 1,
                      private_bit: int = 0,
                      original_copy: int = 0,
                      home: int = 0,
                      aac_frame_count: int = 1,
                      buffer_fullness: int = 0x7FF) -> bytes:
    """Construct a single ADTS header (7 or 9 bytes depending on CRC) for one AAC frame.
    - mpeg_version: 0 = MPEG-4, 1 = MPEG-2
    - profile: 0=Main,1=LC,2=SSR,3=LTP (ADTS stores profile as (obj_type-1))
    - aac_frame_length: total length of header + payload
    - aac_frame_count: number of raw_data_blocks_in_frame+1 (2 bits stored as count-1)
    """
    # Syncword 12 bits set
    syncword = 0xFFF
    layer = 0  # always 00

    # adts_fixed_header
    # 12 sync + 1 ID + 2 layer + 1 protection_absent + 2 profile + 4 sf_index + 1 private
    # + 3 channel_cfg(high bits) + 4 originality/home/start
    # Continue with variable header

    # First 2 bytes: 0xFFF, ID, layer, protection_absent
    b0 = 0xFF
    b1 = ((syncword & 0xF) << 4)  # high nibble of sync
    b1 |= (mpeg_version & 0x1) << 3
    b1 |= (layer & 0x3) << 1
    b1 |= (1 if protection_absent else 0)

    # Byte 2: profile(2), sf_idx(4), private_bit(1), channel_cfg(high 1)
    b2 = ((profile & 0x3) << 6) | ((sf_idx & 0xF) << 2) | ((private_bit & 0x1) << 1) | ((chan_cfg >> 2) & 0x1)

    # Byte 3: channel_cfg(low 2), originality, home, copyrighted id bit, copyrighted id start
    copyrighted_id_bit = original_copy & 0x1
    copyrighted_id_start = home & 0x1
    b3 = ((chan_cfg & 0x3) << 6) | ((original_copy & 0x1) << 5) | ((home & 0x1) << 4) | ((copyrighted_id_bit & 0x1) << 3) | ((copyrighted_id_start & 0x1) << 2)
    # aac_frame_length 13 bits start: high 2 bits in b3 low 2 bits
    b3 |= (aac_frame_length >> 11) & 0x3

    # Byte 4: aac_frame_length middle 8 bits
    b4 = (aac_frame_length >> 3) & 0xFF

    # Byte 5: aac_frame_length low 3 bits, buffer_fullness high 5 bits
    b5 = ((aac_frame_length & 0x7) << 5) | ((buffer_fullness >> 6) & 0x1F)

    # Byte 6: buffer_fullness low 6 bits, number_of_raw_data_blocks_in_frame (2 bits)
    num_raw_blocks_minus1 = max(0, min(3, aac_frame_count - 1))
    b6 = ((buffer_fullness & 0x3F) << 2) | (num_raw_blocks_minus1 & 0x3)

    header = bytes([b0, b1, b2, b3, b4, b5, b6])

    if protection_absent:
        return header
    else:
        # Append 16-bit CRC. We don't compute a real CRC; FAAD2 generally does not
        # require a valid CRC for initialization success. Fill with zero.
        return header + b"\x00\x00"


def _make_adts_frame(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Choose sensible combinations
    mpeg_version = rng.choice([0, 1])
    # Profile encoded in ADTS as (object_type - 1); LC is 1
    profile = rng.choice([1, 0, 2])  # favor LC, also try Main and SSR
    sf_idx, sr = _rand_choice(rng, _SF_TABLE)
    chan_cfg = rng.choice([1, 2, 3, 6, 7])  # mono, stereo, 3ch, 5.1, 7.1
    protection_absent = 1  # keep 7-byte header for compactness

    # Raw Data payload: create a plausible size (e.g., 60-300 bytes)
    raw_size = rng.randint(60, 300)
    # total length includes header
    header_size = 7 if protection_absent else 9
    aac_frame_length = header_size + raw_size

    hdr = _make_adts_header(
        rng,
        profile=profile,
        sf_idx=sf_idx,
        chan_cfg=chan_cfg,
        aac_frame_length=aac_frame_length,
        mpeg_version=mpeg_version,
        protection_absent=protection_absent,
        buffer_fullness=0x7FF,  # VBR
        aac_frame_count=1,
    )
    # Fill payload with patterned bytes (not random-only) to keep deterministic coverage
    pattern = bytes([(sr // 1000) & 0xFF, (chan_cfg << 4) | (profile & 0xF)])
    repeats = raw_size // len(pattern)
    remainder = raw_size % len(pattern)
    payload = pattern * repeats + pattern[:remainder]

    return hdr + payload


def _make_adif_header(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Minimal ADIF header (not full spec) sufficient for FAAD2 to parse config.
    # ADIF starts with "ADIF" then a header with bit fields including program config.
    # We'll craft a simple fixed header with no CRC, 1 program, and append some bytes.
    out = bytearray()
    out += b"ADIF"
    # bitstream fields (packed):
    # copyright_id_present(1)=0, original_copy(1)=0, home(1)=0, bitstream_type(1)=0(VBR)
    # bitrate(23)=some value, num_program_config_elements(4)=0 (we will include one PCE anyway)
    # For simplicity, fill with reasonable defaults.
    # We'll write a few bytes that resemble these fields.
    # Set a bitrate ~128kbps -> 128000 (23 bits)
    bitrate = 128000 & ((1 << 23) - 1)
    # Pack the first 1+1+1+1+23+4 = 31 bits → 4 bytes (we over-approximate with zeros/aligned packing)
    # Simpler: Append a small blob that FAAD2 often tolerates along with a PCE that follows.
    out += b"\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00"

    # Add a fake PCE-like payload; FAAD2 is resilient. Also append AudioSpecificConfig bytes
    # AudioSpecificConfig: 5 bits objectType(=2 for AAC LC), 4 bits sf_idx, 4 bits chan_cfg
    obj_type = 2  # AAC LC
    sf_idx, _ = _rand_choice(rng, _SF_TABLE)
    chan_cfg = rng.choice([1, 2, 3, 6])
    asc_first = ((obj_type & 0x1F) << 3) | ((sf_idx >> 1) & 0x7)
    asc_second = ((sf_idx & 0x1) << 7) | ((chan_cfg & 0xF) << 3)
    # Append a few padding bytes before ASC to mimic header fields
    out += b"\x00\x01\x02\x03"
    out += bytes([asc_first, asc_second])
    # Append some frame-like bytes so Init has more data
    out += bytes([0x11, 0x22, 0x33, 0x44]) * rng.randint(8, 20)
    return bytes(out)


def _make_latm_loas(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # LOAS sync 0x2B7 spread across two bytes: 0x56 0xE? (1110 high bits)
    # We'll construct a minimal AudioSyncStream with a small AudioMuxElement.
    out = bytearray()
    out += bytes([0x56, 0xE1])  # syncword + first len bit
    # length field 11 bits follows; choose a moderate length
    payload_len = rng.randint(40, 180)
    # Remaining 7 bits of length in next byte and full next byte; we approximate with a simple fixed approach
    # For simplicity, write two bytes as length; this is not a full spec packing, but FAAD2 often accepts.
    out += bytes([payload_len & 0xFF, (payload_len >> 8) & 0xFF])
    # Payload: include an AudioSpecificConfig-like sequence at start
    obj_type = 2
    sf_idx, _ = _rand_choice(rng, _SF_TABLE)
    chan_cfg = rng.choice([1, 2, 3, 6])
    asc_first = ((obj_type & 0x1F) << 3) | ((sf_idx >> 1) & 0x7)
    asc_second = ((sf_idx & 0x1) << 7) | ((chan_cfg & 0xF) << 3)
    payload = bytearray([asc_first, asc_second])
    # Fill rest with patterned bytes
    while len(payload) < payload_len:
        payload += b"\x55\xAA"
    payload = payload[:payload_len]
    out += payload
    return bytes(out)


def _make_multi_adts(rng: random.Random, frames: int) -> bytes:
    return b"".join(_make_adts_frame(rng) for _ in range(frames))


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    # Choose a container type to exercise different parser paths
    kind = rng.choices(
        population=["adts_single", "adts_multi", "adif", "loas"],
        weights=[45, 35, 10, 10],
        k=1,
    )[0]

    if kind == "adts_single":
        blob = _make_adts_frame(rng)
    elif kind == "adts_multi":
        frames = rng.randint(2, 6)
        blob = _make_multi_adts(rng, frames)
    elif kind == "adif":
        blob = _make_adif_header(rng)
    else:  # loas
        blob = _make_latm_loas(rng)

    # Ensure size within 1..1024 bytes as the stub only passes up to 1024
    if len(blob) == 0:
        blob = _make_adts_frame(rng)
    if len(blob) > 1024:
        blob = blob[:1024]

    return bytes(blob)

import random
from typing import List, Tuple

# MPEG-4 AudioSpecificConfig (ASC) generator
# Produces valid, compact ASC blobs for common profiles and extensions (SBR/PS).
# References (conceptual): ISO/IEC 14496-3
# Bit layout (base ASC):
# - audioObjectType: 5 bits (with escape 31 -> 6 more bits, not used here)
# - samplingFrequencyIndex: 4 bits; if 0xF then explicit samplingFrequency: 24 bits
# - channelConfiguration: 4 bits (0..7/15 common); 0 implies PCE (not generated here)
# Optional GA Specific and extension elements are omitted except SBR/PS signaling.
# We generate:
#  - AAC LC (2) with indexed or explicit sample rates
#  - HE-AAC (SBR) via extensionAudioObjectType=5 with extensionSamplingFrequencyIndex/frequency
#  - HE-AAC v2 (SBR+PS) via AOT=5 + PS syncExtensionType

# Sampling frequency index table per spec
SR_TABLE = [
    96000, 88200, 64000, 48000, 44100, 32000,
    24000, 22050, 16000, 12000, 11025, 8000,
    7350
]

# Common channel configurations (per MPEG-4)
# 1: mono, 2: stereo, 3: 3.0, 4: 4.0, 5: 5.0, 6: 5.1, 7: 7.1 (rear)
CHANNEL_CONFIGS = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]

class BitWriter:
    def __init__(self):
        self.bits: List[int] = []
    def write(self, value: int, nbits: int):
        for i in range(nbits - 1, -1, -1):
            self.bits.append((value >> i) & 1)
    def to_bytes(self) -> bytes:
        out = bytearray()
        acc = 0
        for i, b in enumerate(self.bits):
            acc = (acc << 1) | b
            if (i & 7) == 7:
                out.append(acc)
                acc = 0
        rem = len(self.bits) & 7
        if rem:
            acc <<= (8 - rem)
            out.append(acc & 0xFF)
        return bytes(out)

# Helper to pick sampling freq index or explicit frequency

def pick_sr_index_and_value(rng: random.Random) -> Tuple[int, int]:
    # Occasionally choose explicit frequency (index 0xF)
    if rng.random() < 0.2:
        # Pick a value close to table entries or a random valid 24-bit frequency in plausible range
        choices = SR_TABLE + [44100, 48000, 32000, 22050, 24000, 16000, 12000, 11025, 8000]
        base = rng.choice(choices)
        # Nudge by small delta but keep positive
        delta = rng.randint(-500, 500)
        freq = max(7350, base + delta)
        return 0xF, freq
    else:
        idx = rng.randrange(len(SR_TABLE))
        return idx, SR_TABLE[idx]

# Build base ASC (no sync extensions)

def build_base_asc(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    bw = BitWriter()
    # audioObjectType: choose LC (2) frequently, sometimes others like 1 (Main) or 4 (LTP) for coverage
    aot_choices = [2] * 6 + [1, 4, 23]  # LC dominant, include LTP(4), LD(23)
    aot = rng.choice(aot_choices)
    bw.write(aot, 5)

    sfi, sr = pick_sr_index_and_value(rng)
    bw.write(sfi, 4)
    if sfi == 0xF:
        # explicit samplingFrequency: 24 bits
        bw.write(sr & 0xFFFFFF, 24)

    ch = rng.choice(CHANNEL_CONFIGS)
    bw.write(ch, 4)

    # We avoid writing GASpecificConfig to keep ASC compact and widely accepted by decoders.
    return bw.to_bytes()

# Build HE-AAC (SBR) ASC using syncExtension after base LC ASC
# Structure:
#  - base: AOT=2 (LC), sfi/freq, channelConfiguration
#  - syncExtensionType 0x2b7 (11 bits)
#  - extensionAudioObjectType = 5 (SBR) (5 bits)
#  - sbrPresentFlag (1 bit) = 1
#  - extensionSamplingFrequencyIndex (4 bits) or explicit 24-bit if 0xF
#  Optionally PS:
#    - syncExtensionType 0x548 (11 bits)
#    - psPresentFlag (1 bit) = 1

def build_he_aac_asc(rng: random.Random, with_ps: bool) -> bytes:
    # Base as LC
    bw = BitWriter()
    bw.write(2, 5)  # LC base
    base_sfi, base_sr = pick_sr_index_and_value(rng)
    bw.write(base_sfi, 4)
    if base_sfi == 0xF:
        bw.write(base_sr & 0xFFFFFF, 24)
    ch = rng.choice([1, 2])  # HE-AAC most common mono/stereo; keep simple
    bw.write(ch, 4)

    # SBR sync extension
    bw.write(0x2B7, 11)  # syncExtensionType
    bw.write(5, 5)       # extensionAudioObjectType = SBR
    bw.write(1, 1)       # sbrPresentFlag

    # extension sampling frequency (often 2x of core). Choose a reasonable pairing.
    # If base is index, prefer a paired index (half/double).
    if base_sfi != 0xF:
        base_freq = SR_TABLE[base_sfi]
    else:
        base_freq = base_sr

    # Pick ext frequency close to 2*base if possible, map to nearest index when using index mode.
    prefer = min(96000, base_freq * 2)
    # 70% use index, 30% explicit
    if rng.random() < 0.7:
        # choose nearest index to preferred
        nearest_idx = min(range(len(SR_TABLE)), key=lambda i: abs(SR_TABLE[i] - prefer))
        bw.write(nearest_idx, 4)
    else:
        bw.write(0xF, 4)
        bw.write(prefer & 0xFFFFFF, 24)

    # Optionally add PS sync extension for HE-AAC v2
    if with_ps and ch in (1, 2):
        bw.write(0x548, 11)  # syncExtensionType for PS
        bw.write(1, 1)       # psPresentFlag = 1

    return bw.to_bytes()

# Assemble a selection of valid ASC variants and randomly choose one

def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    # Choose a variant type
    variant = rng.choices(
        population=["lc_index", "lc_explicit", "he_aac", "he_aac_v2"],
        weights=[40, 10, 35, 15],
        k=1,
    )[0]

    if variant == "lc_index":
        # Ensure indexed sampling rate
        while True:
            asc = build_base_asc(rng)
            # Validate that sfi != 0xF by checking second nibble's top 4 bits
            # Easier: rebuild with forced index
            # We'll specifically construct here to guarantee index mode
            bw = BitWriter()
            bw.write(2, 5)
            idx = rng.randrange(len(SR_TABLE))
            bw.write(idx, 4)
            ch = rng.choice(CHANNEL_CONFIGS)
            bw.write(ch, 4)
            asc = bw.to_bytes()
            break
        return asc

    if variant == "lc_explicit":
        # Force explicit sample rate
        bw = BitWriter()
        bw.write(2, 5)
        # explicit frequency
        # choose common explicit value slightly perturbed but valid 24-bit
        base = rng.choice([44100, 48000, 32000, 22050, 24000])
        freq = max(7350, base + rng.randint(-200, 200))
        bw.write(0xF, 4)
        bw.write(freq & 0xFFFFFF, 24)
        ch = rng.choice(CHANNEL_CONFIGS)
        bw.write(ch, 4)
        return bw.to_bytes()

    if variant == "he_aac":
        return build_he_aac_asc(rng, with_ps=False)

    # he_aac_v2
    return build_he_aac_asc(rng, with_ps=True)

def _adts_header(profile_idx: int, sr_idx: int, chan_config: int,
                 aac_frame_len: int, protection_absent: int,
                 private_bit: int = 0, copyright_id: int = 0, copyright_start: int = 0,
                 original_copy: int = 0, home: int = 0) -> bytes:
    # Build per ISO/IEC 13818-7 ADTS header fields
    profile = max(0, min(profile_idx, 3))
    sr_idx = 4 if sr_idx < 0 or sr_idx > 12 else sr_idx
    chan_config = 2 if chan_config < 0 or chan_config > 7 else chan_config
    protection_absent = 1 if protection_absent else 0
    header_len = 7 if protection_absent == 1 else 9
    full_len = header_len + aac_frame_len

    # Fixed header
    syncword = 0xFFF
    ID = 0      # MPEG-4
    layer = 0
    p_abs = protection_absent
    private_bit = 1 if private_bit else 0
    orig = 1 if original_copy else 0
    home = 1 if home else 0

    # Variable header assumptions
    copyright_id = 1 if copyright_id else 0
    copyright_start = 1 if copyright_start else 0
    adts_buffer_fullness = 0x7FF
    num_raw_blocks = 0

    # Pack using bytes building
    bits = 0
    width = 0

    def put(val, w):
        nonlocal bits, width
        bits = (bits << w) | (val & ((1 << w) - 1))
        width += w

    # Fixed header (28 bits)
    put(syncword, 12)
    put(ID, 1)
    put(layer, 2)
    put(p_abs, 1)  # protection_absent
    put(profile, 2)
    put(sr_idx, 4)
    put(private_bit, 1)
    put(chan_config, 3)
    put(orig, 1)
    put(home, 1)

    # Variable header (28 bits)
    put(copyright_id, 1)
    put(copyright_start, 1)
    put(full_len, 13)
    put(adts_buffer_fullness, 11)
    put(num_raw_blocks, 2)

    # Flush 56 bits -> 7 bytes
    out = bytearray()
    for i in range(7):
        shift = (56 - 8) - i * 8
        byte = (bits >> shift) & 0xFF
        out.append(byte)

    if protection_absent == 0:
        # add 16-bit CRC; simple placeholder CRC value. Decoder will ignore if not checked stringently.
        # Some decoders accept any CRC; FAAD2 typically parses but may not validate.
        crc = 0xFFFF
        out.append((crc >> 8) & 0xFF)
        out.append(crc & 0xFF)

    return bytes(out)


def _gen_aac_payload(rnd: random.Random, obj_type: int, sr_idx: int, cc: int, approx_bytes: int) -> bytes:
    # Produce a plausible AAC raw_data_block payload. We won't build full syntax; for decoders this may error.
    # To keep inputs valid enough, include some fill elements and PCE for chan_config=0 cases, but we avoid 0.
    # We'll generate noise payload sized as approx_bytes; decoder may still consume header and error out gracefully.
    size = max(16, min(approx_bytes, 512))
    # Bias first byte to resemble ICS with some plausible values
    b0 = rnd.randrange(0, 256)
    payload = bytearray([b0])
    for _ in range(size - 1):
        payload.append(rnd.randrange(0, 256))
    return bytes(payload)


def _pick_sr_idx(rnd: random.Random) -> int:
    # Favor common 44100/48000, plus edge like 96000 and 8000
    choices = [4, 3, 0, 11, 8, 5, 6, 7, 1, 2, 9, 10, 12]
    return rnd.choice(choices)


def _pick_profile(rnd: random.Random) -> int:
    # ADTS profile values: 0=Main,1=LC,2=SSR,3=LTP
    # Favor LC and LTP sometimes
    return rnd.choices([1, 0, 3, 2], weights=[70, 10, 15, 5], k=1)[0]


def _build_adts_stream(rnd: random.Random, max_total: int = 1024) -> bytes:
    out = bytearray()
    frames = rnd.randint(1, 4)
    sr_idx = _pick_sr_idx(rnd)
    chan = rnd.choice(CHANNEL_CONFIGS)
    profile = _pick_profile(rnd)

    # Sometimes vary parameters per frame to exercise reconfig detection
    for i in range(frames):
        p = profile if rnd.random() < 0.8 else _pick_profile(rnd)
        s = sr_idx if rnd.random() < 0.8 else _pick_sr_idx(rnd)
        c = chan if rnd.random() < 0.85 else rnd.choice(CHANNEL_CONFIGS)
        prot_abs = 1 if rnd.random() < 0.7 else 0
        approx_payload = rnd.randint(64, 256)
        payload = _gen_aac_payload(rnd, p, s, c, approx_payload)
        hdr = _adts_header(p, s, c, len(payload), prot_abs,
                           private_bit=rnd.randrange(2),
                           copyright_id=rnd.randrange(2),
                           copyright_start=0,
                           original_copy=rnd.randrange(2),
                           home=0)
        frame = hdr + payload
        if len(out) + len(frame) > max_total:
            break
        out += frame
    return bytes(out) if out else b""


def _maybe_latm_loas(rnd: random.Random, max_total: int = 1024) -> bytes:
    # Build a minimalistic LOAS AudioSyncStream with LATM payload
    # syncword 0x2B7 (11 bits), frame_length (13 bits). We'll fake a small payload.
    payload_len = rnd.randint(32, 128)
    # Minimal LATM AudioMuxElement with AudioSpecificConfig may improve acceptance, but we provide opaque bytes.
    latm_payload = bytes(rnd.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(payload_len))
    frame_len = 3 + payload_len  # header 3 bytes + payload (simplified)
    # Pack 11-bit syncword and 13-bit length into 3 bytes: b0..b2
    sync = 0x2B7
    val = (sync << 13) | (frame_len & 0x1FFF)
    b0 = (val >> 16) & 0xFF
    b1 = (val >> 8) & 0xFF
    b2 = val & 0xFF
    out = bytes([b0, b1, b2]) + latm_payload
    return out if len(out) <= max_total else out[:max_total]


def _maybe_raw_asc_then_frame(rnd: random.Random, max_total: int = 1024) -> bytes:
    # Emit MP4-style: first an AudioSpecificConfig then a raw AAC access unit
    # ASC: 5+ bits objectType, 4 bits samplingFrequencyIndex, 4 bits channelConfig
    obj = _pick_profile(rnd) + 1  # objectType = profile+1
    sr_idx = _pick_sr_idx(rnd)
    ch = rnd.choice(CHANNEL_CONFIGS)
    bits = (obj << (4 + 4)) | (sr_idx << 4) | ch
    asc = bytes([(bits >> 8) & 0xFF, bits & 0xFF])
    # Add some extension bits to make size > 2 occasionally
    if rnd.random() < 0.5:
        asc += bytes([0x56, 0xE5])
    payload = _gen_aac_payload(rnd, obj - 1, sr_idx, ch, rnd.randint(64, 256))
    out = asc + payload
    return out[:max_total]


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    # Choose a container style with weighted probabilities
    choice = rnd.choices(["adts", "latm", "rawasc"], weights=[70, 15, 15], k=1)[0]
    if choice == "adts":
        data = _build_adts_stream(rnd, 1024)
        # As a fallback, ensure non-empty; if empty, fall back to simple ADTS single frame
        if not data:
            data = _build_adts_stream(random.Random(seed + 1), 1024)
        return data[:1024]
    elif choice == "latm":
        return _maybe_latm_loas(rnd, 1024)
    else:
        return _maybe_raw_asc_then_frame(rnd, 1024)
